LocalMind
brand guide

Direction A, Orbit. Calm, focused and dependable: a developer instrument, not an AI toy.

The mark

A glowing core inside nested circles, with three bookmark nodes orbiting it. The core is your machine and the bookmarks are the tools you keep close. Flat geometry, one color, a soft glow and nothing else.

The mark is always drawn from the supplied files. Do not redraw it, recolor it outside the palette, or add effects.

Lockups

Use the horizontal lockup by default and the stacked one for square spaces. On light backgrounds the wordmark switches to Ink and the deeper pink.

Size tiers

The icon has three cuts. Pick by rendered size, not by file name. Small sizes drop the thin orbit and connectors so the shape still reads.

CutUse atContains
Fullabove 96 pxGlow, orbit, connectors, ring, core, bookmarks
Small25 to 96 pxRing, core, larger bookmarks
Tiny24 px and belowRing, core, three solid dots

Clear space around the lockup: the height of the core ring on every side. Minimum widths: icon 16 px, horizontal lockup 120 px.

Type

LocalMind
Wordmark: Inter Light + Inter Bold, tracking −1%. Shipped as outlined paths.

Inside the app, keep the system sans stack. Use monospace for commands, ports and the /localmind handle. Headlines in marketing are Inter Bold, tight, with the last line in the primary pink.

Voice

Your private AI hub, always nearby.Tagline. Use it as written.

Short, plain sentences. Say what it does and who is in control. Avoid hype words, exclamation marks, and anything about brains, robots or magic.

Do and don't

Do

  • Keep the mark on Canvas, Card, Paper or the icon tile.
  • Use the cut that matches the size.
  • Let the pink be the one accent.

Don't

  • Add neon glows, gradients or sparkles.
  • Stretch, rotate or outline the mark.
  • Set the pink on Paper. Use the deeper pink.

Social

Posts keep the lockup top left, a headline bottom left with its last line in pink, and the handle at the foot. Post copy beyond the tagline is placeholder and should be confirmed.
